title: Voronoi cells grow in giraffes, mud and dragonfly wings
body: Partitioning by 'closer to my seed than yours' produces Voronoi diagrams, and nature keeps reinventing them: giraffe patches, basalt columns, leaf veins and soap foams approximate them because local growth rules generate them. Red Blob Games' explorables made them a programmer's staple for maps. The same diagram organises cell towers and postcodes on your phone.
